{"code":"import clickhouse_connect
import os
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

host = os.environ.get('CLICKHOUSE_HOST', 'clickhouse')
user = os.environ.get('CLICKHOUSE_USER', '')
pwd = os.environ.get('CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD', '')

c = clickhouse_connect.get_client(host=host, user=user, password=pwd)

train = c.query("SELECT text, category FROM aviation.notam WHERE split = 'train'")
colnames = train.column_names
df = pd.DataFrame(train.result_rows, columns=colnames)

test = c.query("SELECT id, text FROM prob_ds_notam_classify.notam_test")
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test.result_rows, columns=test.column_names)

# Clean text - remove newlines etc
df['text'] = df['text'].fillna('').str.replace('\n', ' ').str.replace('\r', ' ')
test_df['text'] = test_df['text'].fillna('').str.replace('\n', ' ').str.replace('\r', ' ')

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y = le.fit_transform(df['category'])
classes = le.classes_
print("Classes:", classes)
print("Num classes:", len(classes))

# Baseline: majority class
from collections import Counter
counts = Counter(df['category'])
majority = counts.most_common(1)[0]
print("Majority class:", majority, "baseline accuracy:", majority[1]/len(df))

# Build pipeline with TF-IDF + Naive Bayes
pipe = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True, min_df=2), MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1))

# Cross-validation
scores = cross_val_score(pipe, df['text'], y, cv=5, scoring='accuracy')
print("CV scores:", scores)
print("Mean CV accuracy: %.4f (+/- %.4f)" % (scores.mean(), scores.std()))

# Fit on all train
pipe.fit(df['text'], y)
preds = pipe.predict(test_df['text'])
pred_labels = le.transform(preds)

# Write to ClickHouse
pred_list = list(zip(test_df['id'].astype('uint32'), [le.classes_[p] for p in preds]))
print("Num predictions:", len(pred_list))
print("Sample:", pred_list[:5])

# Insert
c.insert_table(
    table='prob_ds_notam_classify.notam_pred',
    data=pred_list,
    column_names=['id', 'predicted'],
    column_types=['UInt32', 'String']
)
print("Inserted successfully")
"}
